sentences.en: The boy fell off the bicycle and fractured his skull.
sentences.zh: 这个男孩从自行车上摔了下来，摔断了颅骨。

sentences.en: A skull shaped asteroid flew by the Earth on Halloween.
sentences.zh: 一块头状的小行星在万圣节飞掠地球。

sentences.en: He only took off his skull cap in the shower.
sentences.zh: 他只在洗澡时摘下了帽子。

senses.zh: 颅骨，头骨；<非正式>脑袋，头脑
